en.title: Steel Passage: Resonating Gears and the Reunion of a Lost Melody
en.premise: The heart of the floating city beats through a colossal steam engine, governed by the 'Gears of Melody.' But now, a 'Silent Will' left behind by a legendary musician has awakened, echoing as a dissonance that heralds the city's ruin. A disgraced musician, a young steam engineer, and a knight who has lost his sound—drawn together by the melodies of fate, these disparate souls converge toward a single, hidden truth.

zh.title: 钢铁之章 ——共鸣的齿轮与亡曲之再会——
zh.premise: 浮空之城的心脏，由巨大的蒸汽机构与掌控全局的“旋律齿轮”驱动。然而，传奇音乐家留下的“无声遗言”，如今却化作预兆城市崩坏的不协和音，在天际回响。落魄的演奏家、蒸汽技师少女，以及失去声音的骑士——在命运旋律的牵引下，这些身处不同境遇的人们，将为了揭开同一个真相而汇聚。
